AGENDA
  CDBG ADVISORY COMMITTEE SPECIAL MEETING
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
 Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
 verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
 glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
 using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings are also
 archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818) 548-4013 for
 program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the Community Services
 & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA 91206.
 If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
 Community Services & Parks Administration Office at (818) 548-2782 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks Administration
 Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish
 to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the Community
 Services & Parks Administration Office at (818) 548-2782, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled
 meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
 provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
 in their native language.
  OCTOBER 14, 2021 AT 2:30 PM

To help slow the transmission of COVID-19, and protect the health and safety of the community, City
Council, as well as Board & Commission meetings, will continue to be closed to the public for in-person
attendance.
The public is encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social
distancing. Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and
AT&T U-verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu.
For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a
specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed.
   A SPECIAL MEETING of the CDBG Advisory Committee is hereby called to meet at 2:30 PM
on October 14, 2021, via teleconference to consider the following item of business, to wit:
1.  ROLL CALL
  a. Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the October
  14, 2021 special meeting of the CDBG Advisory Committee was posted on or before
  Monday, October 11, 2021, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
2.  MINUTES
  a. Approval of the Minutes of the August 30, 2021, CDBG Advisory Committee Special
  Meeting.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5)
  minutes. The Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.
  Staff may refer the matter to the proper section or department for investigation and report.
4.  ACTION ITEMS
  a. Selection of CDBG Advisory Committee Officers
  1. Selection of Chair for the term October 2021 - October 2022
  2. Selection of Vice-Chair for the term October 2021 - October 2022
  b. Preliminary Proposed FY 2022-2023 CDBG Funding Allocation Plan by Funding
  Category
  1. Motion to approve the Preliminary Proposed FY 2022-2023 CDBG Funding Allocation
  Plan by Funding Category
  c. FY 2022-2023 CDBG Program Priorities
  1. Motion to approve the FY 2022-2023 CDBG Program Priorities
  d. FY 2022-2023 CDBG Public Social Services Request for Funding Proposal (RFP)
  Packet
  1. Motion to approve the FY 2022-2023 CDBG Public Social Services Request for
  Proposal (RFP) Packet
  e. FY 2022-2023 CDBG Capital Improvement Project Request for Proposal (RFP)
  Packet
  1. Motion to approve the FY 2022-2023 CDBG Capital Improvement Project Request for
  Proposal (RFP) Packet
5.  COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS
6.  ADJOURNMENT
